cost_control_decisions: reuse or rent before buying a bespoke component
buy human service and independent review before buying an AI display
separate one-off setup from every recurring shift and maintenance cost
include removal, data deletion, and site restoration in the same quote as installation
stop procurement when the named operator or recurring budget is missing

service_targets.target: 100% of released services show a named human takeover point
100% of severe safety or privacy events trigger immediate stop
Every public listing has source, update date, owner, and expiry
Every published route passes an end-to-end no-app walkthrough

claim_boundary: No venue, budget, operator, permit, partner, procurement, or implementation commitment is confirmed by this playbook.
